card.name: Lesson plan section headings
card.fires_on: Section headings and connecting words in classroom lesson plans, such as Resources, Lesson, Warm-Up and WRAP-UP, mainly in New York Times Learning Network lessons.

modes.label: Lesson plan headings
modes.description: The first word of a section heading such as Resources or Lesson that follows a numbered list of student activities.
modes.example: letters to state legislators. <<Resources>> / Materials: -five index cards with instructions

modes.label: Words inside lesson steps
modes.description: Small words or punctuation within descriptions of what students and teachers do in a lesson.
modes.example: read the news report and participate<< in>> a think-pair-share discussion. Lesson
